description: The file defines a PHP class 'ReturnReason' within the Opencart admin module, responsible for managing return reasons in the localisation context, including listing, creating, editing, and deleting return reason entries.

classes.name: ReturnReason
classes.description: Controller class for managing return reasons in the admin localisation section of Opencart. Handles CRUD operations, listing, and form rendering for return reasons.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry that initializes the list page, loads language files, sets up breadcrumbs, and renders the return reason list view.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns the list of return reasons, mainly by calling getList and outputting its result.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Generates the data required for the return reasons list, including pagination, URLs, and fetching data from the model.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for adding or editing a return reason, loads necessary data such as languages and existing descriptions.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the submission of the create/edit form, validates data and permissions, then saves the return reason.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected return reasons after permission checks and necessary validation against existing returns.
